experiment_data.hypothesis: RSFT training on CED-filtered data (2718 samples, mean CED=0.668). SFT warmup baseline: rel_f1=0.4057, evi_f1=0.798. Pass criteria: rel_f1 > 0.4057 AND evi_f1 > 0.798.

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/autodl-tmp && HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 python -m freige.training.rsft_trainer --base_model /root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen3-4B --sft_adapter /root/autodl-tmp/sft_output --rsft_data_path /root/autodl-tmp/rsft_filtered/rsft_train.jsonl --output_dir /root/autodl-tmp/rsft_output --learning_rate 2e-5 --num_epochs 3 --per_device_batch_size 4 --gradient_accumulation_steps 4 --lora_rank 64 --lora_alpha 128 --weighted_sampling --eval_data_dir /root/autodl-tmp/data/docred --eval_max_docs 50 --wandb_run_name rsft-ced-r1 --seed 42"
